stop_rules: Do not request payment if the entity/CNPJ or approved operating route is unresolved.
Do not mark an invoice sent or paid if the fiscal route is blocked, unreviewed, or unreconciled.
Do not collect money through a personal, unverified, held, restricted, or unreconciled account.
Pause intake if the LGPD rights path is not ready, if sensitive data arrives, or if privacy review is AI-only.
Do not open intake if support, refund, privacy, payment, or complaint messages cannot be answered by a human within the support targets.
Do not send a paid offer with AI-only terms, unclear refund language, or unclear service limits.
